objective: Define an optional offline mapping between AWG decision packets and LangGraph-style interrupt/checkpoint pause and resume semantics.
assumptions: The mapping is conceptual and does not add a LangGraph dependency to AWG core
Synthetic checkpoints contain no private transcript data
unknowns: Framework-specific serialization and runtime behavior require a separate integration study
invariants: Resume binds to the same execution and checkpoint identity
An interrupt creates a decision request but does not authorize execution
The mapping preserves AWG privacy and revision checks
No framework behavior is claimed from this conceptual mapping alone
acceptance_predicates: A synthetic interrupt produces one bounded AWG packet
A stale checkpoint or decision is rejected
Resume requires a matching decision identity
The mapping remains optional and offline

formalization.scope: offline optional pause and resume mapping
